title: Finite free quotients on Noetherian quasi-affine opens
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian ring, V an open of Spec R, and N a finite locally free O_V-module. There is a natural number r and an epimorphism from O_V^r, indexed by ULift (Fin r), to N. No uniform rank is assumed for N.

source.place: Tag 0EKP, proof of (2) to (3), finite global generation applied to a finite locally free module, specializing the ample invertible module to O_V

proof.text: For every point x of V, apply the local basis extension theorem to obtain an open U_x containing x and a global map from a finite free module to N that restricts to an isomorphism on U_x.

Noetherianity makes V compact. Take a finite subcover of the U_x. Form the map from the free module indexed by the disjoint union of the finite bases, using the corresponding global sections. Each local map factors through it via the inclusion of its basis. At any point choose a member of the finite cover; its map is bijective on that stalk, so the combined map is surjective on the stalk. The stalkwise epimorphism criterion proves it is epi. Reindex the finite disjoint union by ULift (Fin r).

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EKP, global-generation step of (2) to (3); local basis extension, finite subcover, and stalkwise assembly made explicit
